system.description:
Cast a spell when you are out of slots by taking 1d6 damage per spell level.

  • You can only do this while your current HP is higher than the most it could cost (6 per spell level).
  • You can do this a number of times per day equal to your casting-stat modifier (minimum 1).
  • It cannot be used to cast healing spells, and the damage cannot be healed by magic until you complete a long rest.
  • The cost cannot be reduced, resisted or soaked by temporary HP — it comes straight off your HP.

Available to: Wizards, Clerics, Druids, Illusionists, Paladins, Magi, Bards, Sorcerers, Warlocks, Witches, Necromancers, and Artificers.
